title: Repair Spec 014 lease identity and durable run uniqueness guards

phases.objective: Restore exact lease DDL/runtime identity parity and reject ambiguous durable run reads without granting migration or runtime authority.

e2e_journeys.actor: repository reviewer and Spec 014 guard suite
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The reviewed Wave 2 DDL, promoted runtime migration, SQL parent writer, and checksum-bound contracts
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Contract-local and runtime migrations expose id as the lease primary key, target_id remains the unique CAS record key, all checksum evidence is refreshed, and duplicate run rows fail closed.
steps: Patch both reviewed and promoted Wave 2 lease tables with id as the primary key.
Refresh every exact old Wave 2 checksum reference after recomputing the promoted migration digest.
Validate draft/runtime/adapter parity and governed promotion invariants.
Reject more than one durable run row before selecting a normalized candidate.
Exercise the ambiguity regression and changed-line Context Kernel scanner.
assertions: No migration authorization, dry-run, apply, live database, provider, credential, deployment, main, or Production action occurs.
The lease required columns include id, target_id, and lease_id; id is the primary key and target_id remains bound by the active-slot unique key.
The old promoted Wave 2 checksum is absent from the candidate tree.
Ambiguous run identity returns STORAGE_SQL_PARENT_RUN_AMBIGUOUS with bounded secret-free details.
Context Kernel changed-line scanning reports zero runtime blockers.

phases.objective: Observe the repaired guards on the Integration rollup without applying migrations.
blockers: The repair must merge into Integration and produce fresh exact-head guard evidence.

phases.objective: Retain fail-closed behavior under checksum drift, duplicate rows, stale heads, and cancelled evidence publication.
Record green Migration Drafts and Context Kernel evidence on the Rollup exact head.
This repository-only repair grants no migration, runtime, provider, deployment, or Production authority.
